notes_for_editor: Thin: the FFLA list says gone. The Central US Lookouts page for Brainerd gives only the county and a survey code (43N-28W-30) with no history, so the code is left out of the story. Two web searches found no build, staffing or removal history for this tower. The code does not fit the record: Borden Lake's code is 44N-28W-22 about 25 km (16 miles) east, and a survey range is about 10 km wide, so both cannot be R28W. Either the Brainerd code or the record coordinates are wrong. Not corrected; needs a human check. The Pequot Lakes tower (Paul M. Thiede Fire Tower Park) is a different, standing tower and is not used. Suggested sources: Crow Wing County Historical Society, MN DNR forestry records, Brainerd Daily Dispatch archive. Story is far below the about-120-word guide length because the sources are thin; a short honest story was preferred to padding.
